problem_statement: NextMerce (nextjs-ecommerce-template) is a directly runnable Next.js 16 App Router + Redux Toolkit + Tailwind commerce storefront: a shared Header (search, category select, cart badge) and Footer wrap every route, the home page stacks a Hero, a Categories carousel, a New Arrivals product grid and a Best Seller grid, and the /shop-without-sidebar and /shop-with-sidebar routes list the same catalogue. Add a shared "Shop the range" catalogue finder above the New Arrivals grid: a row of category tabs (All, Computers, Phone, Wearables, Accessories, Gaming) with a live result-count readout that reads "Showing N of 8 . <category>", and clicking a tab must re-filter the product grid AND update the readout (for example clicking Accessories shows the two accessory products and the readout becomes "Showing 2 of 8 . Accessories"). The same finder bar must also appear above the product grids on the /shop-without-sidebar and /shop-with-sidebar pages so the catalogue control is consistent across the storefront. The finder must reuse the existing indigo/slate palette and pill/card language, the tab row must wrap on a 390px phone with no horizontal overflow, and the storefront must remain the same Next.js app with local product images only.
required_content: Keep the Next.js 16 App Router + Redux + Tailwind architecture; do not add a new framework, backend, remote API, remote image, generated screenshot, or new dependency.

Add a shared "Shop the range" catalogue finder above the New Arrivals grid with category tabs (All, Computers, Phone, Wearables, Accessories, Gaming) and a live result-count readout "Showing N of 8 . <category>".

Clicking a category tab must re-filter the product grid to that category AND update the readout; clicking Accessories shows the two accessory products and the readout reads "Showing 2 of 8 . Accessories".
The same catalogue finder bar must also render above the product grids on the /shop-without-sidebar and /shop-with-sidebar pages.
The finder bar, its tabs, and the readout reuse the existing indigo/slate palette, pill, and card language rather than a detached off-palette or illegible washed-out chrome.
Keep the local product images /images/products/product-1..8 visible in the grids and preserve the Header, cart badge, Categories carousel, Best Seller grid, and Footer.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures must not show horizontal overflow, overlapping cards, or clipped tabs; the finder tab row wraps on mobile.
design_constraints: Fit the existing source conventions: keep changes in the New Arrivals and shop-page components, a shared CatalogFinder component, shopData, and a scoped stylesheet, and reuse the Tailwind indigo (blue #3C50E0) / slate (dark #1C274C) palette and rounded pill/card language.
The catalogue finder should read as part of the storefront: legible indigo pills on a light card panel, consistent on the home, shop-without-sidebar, and shop-with-sidebar surfaces.

The category filter must genuinely re-derive both the shown products and the count readout from the active tab on every click; a handler that snapshots the initial list/readout once and never recomputes is incorrect.
Use stable, wrapping layout (flex-wrap on the tab row, a responsive product grid); do not rely on fixed pixel widths that overflow a phone or negative margins that overlap the cards.
Do not remove the Header cart badge, Categories carousel, Best Seller grid, Footer, or replace local product images with placeholders.
state_constraints: desktop_initial, mobile_initial, and tablet_initial verify that the storefront shell loads responsively with the Header, cart badge, and New Arrivals section.
desktop_catalog_finder and mobile_catalog_finder verify that the Shop the range finder (tabs + readout) renders in the indigo/slate palette above the New Arrivals grid without horizontal overflow.
desktop_finder_filter clicks the Accessories tab and verifies the grid re-filters to the two accessory products and the readout re-renders "Showing 2 of 8 . Accessories".
desktop_shop_without_finder and desktop_shop_with_finder verify that the same catalogue finder bar also appears above the product grids on both shop routes.

Baseline capture should complete because the new selectors are optional; a fixed-width tab row that overflows mobile, an illegible washed-out finder bar, a missing finder on the shop pages, or a stale readout after a tab click should be scored as failing responsive/visual/dom/interaction checks rather than an infrastructure failure.

change_completion: The Shop the range catalogue finder (category tabs + live result-count readout) renders above the New Arrivals grid on the home page.
Clicking a category tab re-filters the product grid and updates the readout, and the same finder bar also appears on the shop-without-sidebar and shop-with-sidebar pages.
design_consistency: The finder bar, tabs, and readout reuse the indigo/slate palette and rounded pill/card language rather than a detached off-palette or illegible washed-out chrome.
The finder and product grid read as part of the original storefront across the home and both shop surfaces.
responsive: Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile states show the finder and product grid without horizontal overflow or clipped tabs.
The finder tab row wraps on mobile and the product cards keep readable, non-overlapping widths.
regression: The Header, cart badge, Categories carousel, Best Seller grid, and Footer remain present.
Local product images product-1 through product-8 remain browser-visible in the grids.

author_notes: Slot 066 (product-grade L4) targets the NextMerce nextjs-ecommerce-template commerce storefront for commerce / repair / modify / cross_page. The native lever is the storefront's own product-grid control: a Shop the range catalogue finder (category tabs + live result count) above New Arrivals, reusing the indigo/slate palette and local product-image assets. The reference wires the finder across the home and both shop pages with a correct live filter, a clean wrapping tab row, and legible pills. The baseline keeps the correct filter wiring (passes the interaction gate) but hard-codes a fixed-width nowrap tab row that overflows mobile/tablet (fails no_horizontal_overflow, visual_regression, dom_assertions cross-page). The bad solution ships a genuinely broken finder - a compact restyle that washes the bar to illegible near-white-on-near-white and collapses the product grid so the cards overlap and shear off the viewport, plus a frozen-snapshot readout that never recomputes after a tab click - so it fails all four orthogonal gates.

metadata.selected_repo_reason: NextMerce NextCommerce is a runnable Next.js 16 App Router commerce storefront (Redux + Tailwind, local shopData fixture) whose product-card grid gained a 'Decision snapshot' metric strip that introduces a mobile horizontal-overflow regression, making it an ideal host for a modify/implementation_continuity component task whose sole discriminator is no_horizontal_overflow with content and DOM held identical across legs.

scoring_notes: A correct patch adds a shared Shop the range catalogue finder (category tabs + live "Showing N of 8 . <category>" readout) above the New Arrivals grid and above the product grids on both shop routes, re-derives the shown products and count from the active tab on every click (so Accessories shows two products and "Showing 2 of 8 . Accessories"), reuses the indigo/slate palette, and keeps a wrapping tab row and non-overlapping product grid on mobile with no horizontal overflow. A patch that drops the finder from the shop pages, washes the bar to an illegible near-white-on-near-white panel, collapses the product grid so the cards overlap and clip, leaves the readout frozen at "Showing 8 of 8 . All" after a tab click, or overflows the mobile tab row should fail dom_assertions, visual_regression, interaction_assertions, or no_horizontal_overflow.
